cover.sub: 5 niche ways to grow on x
cover.title: when your audience is in 12 time zones

inner.title: the 48 hour clock
inner.body: x's feed code drops posts older than 48 hours before ranking. your berlin morning post is still alive when san francisco wakes up.
inner.label: don't delete it

inner.title: spread, don't stack
inner.body: the code discounts repeat posts from one author in the same feed. five posts before lunch in berlin mostly compete with each other.
inner.label: self-sabotage

inner.title: replies are currency
inner.body: a predicted reply weighs about ten times a like. sleep through new york's replies and the post fades right when it could spread.
inner.label: 10x a like

inner.title: strangers see less
inner.body: posts shown to non-followers reportedly get a 0.75 factor. in a time zone where nobody follows you yet, you start a quarter behind.
inner.label: -25% reach

inner.title: the follow wins
inner.body: a follow from a post counts about eight times a like. one follower in tokyo turns your next post there into an in-network post.
inner.label: 8x a like

closer.HEADLINE:
it's not a reach problem.
it's a clock problem
